scenes.text: In 1932, Australia declared war. Not on a country, but on birds.
Twenty thousand emus had invaded the wheat fields of Western Australia, eating everything in sight.
So the army sent Major Meredith, two soldiers, and two machine guns.
But the emus scattered into small groups and ran faster than the trucks could follow.
After a month and thousands of bullets, the army gave up. The emus had won.
